# spaceman notifications

Your notification preferences: what the web UI announces to you.

Aliases: `notification-preferences`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman notifications get`](#spaceman-notifications-get) | Your notification preferences (defaults until saved) |
| [`spaceman notifications set`](#spaceman-notifications-set) | Change your notification preferences (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman notifications get

Your notification preferences (defaults until saved).

```sh
spaceman notifications get [flags]
```

API: `get-notification-preferences` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman notifications set

Change your notification preferences (only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman notifications set [flags]
```

API: `get-notification-preferences`, `set-notification-preferences` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--assigned-to-me` | bool |  | actions assigned to you |
| `--clarifications` | bool |  | clarification requests and replies |
| `--desktop` | bool |  | also show desktop notifications |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | announce human-action changes in the web UI |
| `--escalations` | bool |  | escalations |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--min-priority` | string |  | low, normal, high or urgent |
| `--mute` | string, repeatable |  | space ID never announced (repeatable; replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--new-actions` | bool |  | new pending actions |
| `--reminders` | bool |  | reminders |
